title: 7th Sitting of first Session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/7/1/2025).
Approval of the minutes of three previous sittings (minutes Nos. 1/1/2025 to 3/1/2025).
From the Speaker's desk: delivery of the reply to the Presidential Address, under Article 33(b) of the Majlis Rules of Procedure.

From the Speaker's desk: the President's nomination of Lieutenant General (Rtd) Abdul Raheem Abdul Latheef (G. Kandithoyige), currently Ambassador to the Republic of Türkiye, as Non-Resident Ambassador to the Russian Federation (Constitution Article 115(d), Foreign Service Act, Law No. 20/2021, Article 14) is sent to the relevant standing committee.

From the Speaker's desk: the President's nomination of Ahmed Sareer (M. Westside), currently Ambassador to the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, as Non-Resident Ambassador to the Kingdom of Morocco is sent to the relevant standing committee.
First reading of the Bill amending the Courts Act (Law No. 22/2010), submitted by Holhudhoo MP Abdul Sattar Mohamed.
Public Finance Committee report on the President's submission on the measures decided for the next two years to cut state expenditure under the economic reform agenda.

Foreign Relations Committee report on the President's nominations for Non-Resident Ambassadors to Brunei Darussalam, the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg, the Kingdom of the Netherlands, France and Australia.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to deliver the reply to the Presidential Address, forward two ambassador nominations to committee, introduce a Courts Act amendment bill, and consider committee reports on expenditure cuts and five ambassador postings.
